title: Lutnick Faces Questions Over Cantor Fitzgerald&\#x27;s Nvidia Holdings
summary: Cantor Fitzgerald, formerly run by Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and now led by his sons, reported a 49% drop in its Nvidia share count between September 2025 and March 2026, from 3.5 million shares worth $652 million to 1.78 million worth $310 million, according to CNBC&\#x27;s review of securities filings; the scrutiny follows Axios reporting that Lutnick resisted a crackdown on alleged Nvidia chip smuggling to China.
